thread:
maria: Planning to run the evening schema migration for user_profiles tonight, need a quick handshake on owners + smoke steps. proposing 21:30 UTC. who can own cutover + rollback?

alex: I can own the cutover and initial smoke. 21:30 UTC works for me. I'll be online 21:00 for prechecks. :thumbsup:

raj: +1 on time. can we confirm dual-write drain strategy? backfill is big, want a short quiet window.

liz: I'm on rollback standby and can coordinate any rollforward if needed. what's our metric guardrail? failure = >=5% write errors or >500ms p99 for profile writes?

alex: proposed guardrails: write error rate >1% for 5m or p99 >700ms triggers rollback. keep dual-write on for 30m after schema flip then cut TTL on old columns.

deploy-bot: scheduled migration job user_profiles_migration_v7 will start at 21:30 UTC. canary set to 5% of traffic for 5m then ramp.

maria: Can we run the smoke checklist and perf probes pre-cutover at 21:05? also need schema migrations reviewed in PR #1129 — @alex did you sanity-check the index order?

alex: yep PR checked. index order aligns with common queries. pre-cutover smoke I'll run below commands at 21:05: 

```
# verify replicas
pg_isready -h replica-read
# run sample reads/writes
python tools/smoke_profile_reads.py --users 100 --duration 60
# run explain on hot query
psql -c "EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM user_profiles WHERE last_active > now() - interval '7 days'"
```

alex: also will warm the read replicas and pre-warm KV cache for sessions.

jordan: how long is the planned dual-write window? we need to make sure downstream consumers are aware.

maria: plan: dual-write enabled for 30 minutes post-switch, then monitor metrics for an additional 30m before flipping consumers. i'll ping downstream owners in #integrations now.

raj: for the backfill — we'll run it in small batches starting 22:00 UTC after the window. backfill script will checkpoint every 10k rows. rollback safepoint will be the pre-migration snapshot at 21:25.

liz: note: have rollback runbook ready and db-admin creds rotated. if we rollback, we will revert the schema change and re-enable old write path. team, please don't run any unrelated migrations in the 3h window.

alex: quick smoke checklist for post-cutover (run at 21:36 during canary):
```
# sanity checks
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/profiles/update -d '{"test":true}' | jq .status
# check write path latency
python tools/check_write_latency.py --threshold 500
# cross-check read replica lag
psql -c "SELECT now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS lag FROM pg_stat_replication;"
```

maria: I'll handle coordination with infra and support to bump on-call page if anything trips. i'll post a status in this thread at each step.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 25% at 21:35 UTC. will post final completion message after full rollout.

alex: I'll be on standby in case we need to abort; fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:

maria: thanks everyone — final confirmations: alex (cutover + smoke), raj (backfill lead), liz (rollback), jordan (downstream comms). please be ready 21:00 UTC for prechecks. I'll update thread with links to runbooks and the exact DB snapshot id once created.

liz: acknowledged.

raj: acknowledged.

jordan: acknowledged, pinging integrations owners now.

maria: status update: prechecks green at 21:10, snapshot id snap-20261201-2110 created, runbooks linked: https://go/runbooks/db-migrations/user_profiles. proceeding to canary at 21:30.
